note: Litres per 100 km by model, overriding the figure the mod works out from the vehicle's weight and power. Model names as the game spells them -- adder, blista, sultan -- and case does not matter. Applied before ConsumptionMultiplier, and only while [Fuel] PerModel is above 0. Example: "adder": 16.0. Delete an entry to go back to the worked-out figure; the log says what that is the first time you drive the model.
